request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
error[ZC-E0822]: the caller's certificate does not allow this request
  cause  client app (scope jobs) may not GET /v1/list: it needs a client of
         scope admin
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    ask an operator for a certificate that allows it:   zcube-server ca issue-client NAME --scope admin
  more   zcube explain E0822
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0822.html
